## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/) (e.g. `feat(bvh): add SAH split`)
- [ ] Targets `develop` (a release or hotfix branch has one PR into `main` and one into `develop`)
- [ ] The checks in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/sergioffpc/umbra/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md#before-opening-a-pull-request) pass (fmt, clippy, doc, nextest, deny, shear, typos)
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Commit headers read as changelog entries (`CHANGELOG.md` is generated by git-cliff)
